newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index gains more than 100 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index gains more than 100 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 100 points in afternoon trading Thursday, boosted by a rally in the bond market.
Just before 3 p.m. EST, the Dow Jones industrial average was up 105.72 points at 6,452.49. In the bond market, the 30-year Treasury bond was up more than a full point.
